### How this work is cited

Passages inside African Philosophy: Myth and Reality are identified by chapter. The English title is not a translation of the French, which is an essay 'On "African philosophy"'. Hountondji's argument is directed against ethnophilosophy — principally against Tempels's Bantu Philosophy and the tradition it founded — which is why the corpus flags the Tempels-related entry.

### The work in Paulin Hountondji’s thought

Paulin J. Hountondji (1942–2024) was a Beninese philosopher educated in Paris (including under Althusser) and long associated with the National University of Benin. [More on Paulin Hountondji](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/paulin-hountondji) .
